specification.question: At fixed K8, does location-preserving future fusion, sparse dependency routing, masked observed-region history, or observed motion selection improve planning and learned selection utility?
specification.decision: No result-dependent architecture choices: all nine conditions preregistered and run in listed priority order, 3 seeds x800. A negative result ends this sweep.
specification.budget_definition: K output region tokens per horizon; native area K*side^2, resolution and token budget reported separately. Encoder/current context always dense.
specification.scope: Same 704 windows and recording split, fixed seeds/update800. Frozen original planner/encoder. Add observed frames0,1 for train-only anchor and IA observed motion. No navtest, no adaptive sweeps. Optional official scorer on these development windows only; it is not a benchmark reproduction.
specification.success_evidence: Report all last-checkpoint runs, paired seed averages and recording-cluster 95% bootstrap intervals, context strata and cost. Preliminary development evidence; do not select checkpoints or claim independent test improvement.

paper_adaptations.SPARTAN: One state-conditioned hard edge layer in future-to-planner bridge, ST threshold and fixed sparsity penalty. No Gumbel sampling, Lagrangian constraint, multi-layer path regularizer or causal claims. Dense attention predictor unchanged.
paper_adaptations.C-JEPA: Training-only hide latest selected spatial-region history, keep earlier two-frame anchor, reconstruct sampled current and all selected futures. Spatial regions are not persistent object identities. Fully observed inference.
paper_adaptations.IA-JEPA: Observed four-frame second difference of absolute pixel changes pooled into8x16, deterministic top8. No future frames, collision labels, learned saliency, or ego-motion compensation.
